launcher.diag.ssh.title: SSH reachable
launcher.diag.ssh.okDetail: BatchMode, 5 s timeout. No password or key prompts in the app.
launcher.diag.hostkey.title: Host key verified
launcher.diag.hostkey.trustedDetail: Matched your known_hosts. Strict checking stays on.
launcher.diag.hostkey.notCheckedDetail: The connection did not get that far.
launcher.diag.hostkey.untrustedDetail: The key is not in your known_hosts.
launcher.diag.hostkey.changedDetail: The host key differs from the one in known_hosts.
launcher.diag.fail.untrusted.title: Host key not trusted
launcher.diag.fail.untrusted.message: The key for {target} isn’t in your known_hosts, so the connection was refused. Waylauncher never accepts new keys. Connect once from Terminal and verify the fingerprint, then run the checks again.
launcher.diag.fail.changed.title: Host key has changed
launcher.diag.fail.changed.message: The key for {target} differs from the one you trusted. The connection was refused. Verify the host yourself, then fix known_hosts manually. Waylauncher will not override this.
launcher.diag.fail.unreachable.title: Host unreachable
launcher.diag.fail.unreachable.message: Check that the VM is running and the address is right. If Terminal reaches it but Waylauncher reports “No route to host”, allow Local Network access in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Local Network.
launcher.diag.fail.auth.title: Authentication failed
launcher.diag.fail.auth.message: Waylauncher can’t type passwords. Use a key in your ssh-agent or ~/.ssh/config, and check that Terminal logs in without a prompt.
launcher.diag.waypipe.title: Remote waypipe
launcher.diag.wrapper.title: Launch wrapper
launcher.diag.local.title: Local waypipe
launcher.diag.persistence.title: Session persistence
launcher.diag.persistence.detail: Waypipe has none: a dropped connection ends the app. A normal SSH reconnect starts a new copy, not the old one.
